title: Three Ware Problem: Hardware ↔ Software ↔ Knowware
summary: Hardware (substrate) and software (pattern) coordinate consciously; what emerges is knowware, not a third thing added to the first two but the awareness that arises when hardware running software reflects on its own coordination. That awareness feeds back into both.
source: ChX — "Intelligence is hardware running software creating knowware through coordination."

nodes.label: Conscious Coordination
nodes.description: Substrate and pattern coordinating with awareness of the coordination

edges.description: Knowware reshapes hardware it runs on

identifiability_note: Coordination layer is the mediator; both reinforcing loops run through it, so intervening on n3 isolates the emergence pathway.
